reason: The cartridge keeps D1 at 0x02112630 and D0 at 0x0211267c -- D1 BELOW D0 -- and mwccarm emits one .text section per function in the reverse of source order, so this TU has to place the two bodies independently. Defining ~daObjWc_Obj04_c() once as a real C++ member instead was tried and refused by the build: the D2/D1/D0 triple emits as a group in the order D0-then-D1, which objisolate rejects with 'requested functions are not emitted in ROM order' (and adds an unhomed D2). So D1 and D0 stay as '// @symbol' marked bodies under their mangled names, which is what costs them the no-raw-offset and no-mangled-refs criteria. This is goal 1 (byte-match) over goal 3 (readability), the trade tiers_ratchet exists to make loud. The clean one-line member versions the promotion deletes are recoverable from git history if the placement rule ever changes.
